channel.title: Pier & Point · Edwin M. Lee Apartments (Block 3 East)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Edwin M. Lee Apartments (Block 3 East) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Edwin M. Lee Apartments (Block 3 East): Edwin M. Lee Apartments: OCII's report lists 119 total units and 118 affordable units, and the permit gives 119 units. The Examiner and the Chinatown Community Development Center say 118 (62 veterans' and 56 family units), while Swords to Plowshares says 62 and 57. No source explains the one-unit difference.
item.description: Edwin M. Lee Apartments: OCII's report lists 119 total units and 118 affordable units, and the permit gives 119 units. The Examiner and the Chinatown Community Development Center say 118 (62 veterans' and 56 family units), while Swords to Plowshares says 62 and 57. No source explains the one-unit difference. Source: OCII Affordable Housing Production Report FY2015-16, p.57 (sfocii.org); Chinatown Community Development Center (chinatowncdc.org/our-portfolio/edwin-m-lee-apartments); Swords to Plowshares (swords-to-plowshares.org/housing-sites/edwin-m-lee-apartments); SF Examiner, 2021-05-04.

item.title: Correction · Edwin M. Lee Apartments (Block 3 East): The map shape for plan block 3E cited nothing. It now cites the December 2019 OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, which shows 3E east of 3W and shaded Residential / Affordable (Venue's block 3W is Residential / Market Rate). The status 'planned', the note about a structure visible in satellite imagery, and any link to the Edwin M. Lee Apartments at 1150 3rd St are unchanged and remain open until a cited source settles them; the shape was not changed.
